title: BARC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Scientific Assistant Posts
description: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) has officially announced a Walk-in Interview for the recruitment of Scientific Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have completed their B.Sc. or Diploma can use this chance and apply for the BARC Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
